name: J. A. Freeze
bio: J. A. Freeze lived in Medora in 1885, when a female member of his family died of cholera infantum in August and was buried on the coal mine butte. He solicited orders for enlarging photographs, working Glendive in October 1885, and moved his family to Glendive in February 1886.

moments.label: Moved with his family to Glendive
